newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brambles shares storm to new highs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brambles shares storm to new highs.

text.p: Shares in transport, logistics and security group Brambles Industries Ltd scaled new heights on Thursday, jumping 80 cents to reach a record high of A$20.50 as investors scrambled to get a piece of what brokers said was a good growth story.
"Most (broking) houses seem to have a bullish outlook on them and their growth, especially in the U.S. pallets business," said a Sydney-based dealer.

After reporting a jump in net profit to A$215.1 million for the 1995/96 year on August 30, compared with A$97.66 million in 1994/95, the company said it was comfortable with forecasts of 10 to 11 percent profit growth for the current 1996/97 year.
In the results, the company said surging profits from its U.S. and European CHEP pallet hire joint ventures compensated for otherwise slow growth in Australia.
Others brokers took a similar tack, saying the company had attracted plenty of buyers and looked even more attractive given the weak earnings outlook for many other market sectors.
"There is an absence of selling in the stock," said director at Burrell and Co, Derek Bond.
"They have a fairly good growth profile, especially given the flat outlook in other sectors, and the funds are chasing the sectors they can get some growth out of," he added.
After some late profit taking, Brambles shares closed 50 cents higher at A$20.20 on turnover of 935,436 shares.
